events.description: 127. ORDER signed by Magistrate Judge Chi Soo Kim on 11/9/26 GRANTING IN PART AND DENYING IN PART 112 , 120 Motions for Leave to take ten additional depositions. County Defendants' 111 & 120 Motion for a protective order regarding the deposi tion of Thomas Boze. County Defendants' 110 & 120 Motion for protective orders regarding the depositions of Defendants Supervisor Matthew Condit, Supervisor Chiesa, Supervisor Withrow, and Supervisor Channce Condit GRANTED IN PART AND DENIE D IN PART. The parties are ordered to meet and confer in-person, by video, or by phone regarding the interrogatories directed to the remaining Defendant Supervisors. Plaintiffs' 113 & 121 Motion to compel further deposition responses from De fendant Hayes is GRANTED IN PART AND DENIED IN PART. Plaintiffs' 105 & 109 Motions to compel further deposition responses from Aron Harris is GRANTED IN PART AND DENIED IN PART. Within 14 days of this order, the parties are ordered to meet and confer as to the case schedule and jointly file a proposed modified case schedule. (Deputy Clerk VLC)
